Name: Pelican Town Municipal - Boggy Castle
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
[color=#29292e]Content[/color]
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-801089181.png[/img][/center]
I envisioned a medieval version of the Municipal Building as a little castle or keep. In my test attempts, it seemed too jail-like. But a Boggy look has some coziness that my original was lacking, so here we are! The new variant shows up on the map as well! Bog colors may seem a bit dark in contrast to vanilla colors, but I've also made versions for multiple other recolors.

There is a setting for green lantern lights to match Bog colors or lantern lights that match whatever recolor you are using. So you can use it just as a medieval building or a full Bog match, your choice. Or maybe it bugs you that the lights here are green and nowhere else in town.

Made for the Stardew Valley Modfest, go team Bog!

[color=#29292e]Compatibility[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906055-1085614367.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Automatic VPR, Starblue, Earthy variants for things like the snow, the lantern light color, leaves and petals on the roof seasonally, and the window lights on the map.[/*]
[*]Overgrown Vintage Map compatibility for the map as well![/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Credits[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-1881551726.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]BogWytch for all the boggy stuff, especially the windows, doors, and color scheme. I altered them and reshaped things, but they're Bog originals.[/*]
[/list]
